baseline_models.focus_anchor: Word 1 fixes the last-night interval, while word 3 is the repeated seeking act.
baseline_models.mechanism: At the night's final exposed interval, the subjects repeatedly seek a covering that does not merely hide fault but protects them from its continuing effect.

activation_trace.role: The final portion of night supplies the recurring temporal threshold for the act.
Covering fault while preserving its bearer from consequence supplies the sought result.

changed_reading.before: They ask pardon during a late-night time.
changed_reading.after: They repeatedly use the night's last threshold for exposed self-accounting and seek protection from the afterlife of their faults.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Word 1 can activate an edge where light overtakes darkness; word 3 can activate a preserving cover.
baseline_models.mechanism: Edge and cover form a passage mechanism: as one temporal register yields to another, the subjects seek a cover fit for crossing rather than a concealment that arrests disclosure.

activation_trace.role: An extremity and the whitening over darkness turn the time noun into a spatially visible boundary.
A preserving cover supplies what can carry the exposed subject across that boundary.

changed_reading.before: Dawn is only the clock-time of a petition.
changed_reading.after: Dawn is a crossing edge, and forgiveness is the protective covering requested for passage into disclosure.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening ordered operations activate a logistics model for the focus: accumulated moral load is separated, acknowledged as weight, moved toward release, and apportioned under a protective petition at dawn.

activation_trace.role: Protection from a fault's consequence anchors the transported load in the focus rather than in the context alone.
Wind-driven separation supplies the first operation, disaggregating what had accumulated.
Bearing an entrusted burden or culpable load identifies what must be processed.
Literal heaviness gives the acknowledged burden material resistance.
Flow supplies movement instead of leaving the burden fixed in place.
Opening into ease supplies the direction of the movement toward release.
Apportionment supplies the terminal operation by which an undifferentiated load is put in order.

structural_cues: 51:1-4 presents a four-step ordered sequence: dispersal, weighted carriage, easy motion, then apportionment.
The focus locates its repeated seeking act in a recurring interval, allowing that sequence to function as a nightly process.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the ordered operations and a focus act concerning fault; I supply the arrow that treats those operations as moral-load processing. A live alternative is that the oath sequence remains cosmological and does not specify the mechanics of seeking forgiveness.

changed_reading.before: The subjects voice a general plea for pardon.
changed_reading.after: Their dawn practice becomes a repeated processing of carried moral weight: separate it, bear it honestly, move it, and submit it for a new apportionment.

context_deltas.mechanism: Promise, verification, reckoning, and fixity make the temporal edge forensic: the subjects seek protective remission before what has been promised settles into an accomplished account.

activation_trace.role: The last-night interval supplies the anticipatory moment before the day opens.
Protection from a fault's consequence supplies the requested forensic change.
A spoken promise that opens expectation supplies the future event toward which the petition faces.
Fulfilment in deed removes the option of treating the promise as indefinite rhetoric.
Account and recompense specify the promised event as settlement.
Falling and becoming fixed make settlement an event that lands rather than a remote abstraction.

structural_cues: 51:5-6 moves from what is promised, through its truth, to an account declared certain to occur.
The focus's habitual plural imperfect answers certainty with repeated preparation rather than a single crisis response.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies promised fulfilment, account, fixity, and consequence-covering; I infer the arrow from impending settlement to anticipatory dawn petition. The live alternative is that the time marks devotion without functioning as a pre-settlement interval.

changed_reading.before: Seeking forgiveness is a pious late-night act.
changed_reading.after: Seeking forgiveness is disciplined preparation before an account that is already on its way to becoming fixed.

context_deltas.mechanism: Divergent commitments and repeated inversion activate the deceptive-turning branch of the focus time-root as an overlay. The petition then seeks release not only from misconduct but from the distortions by which the self makes misconduct appear otherwise.

activation_trace.role: Deceptive redirection supplies an epistemic overlay on the otherwise temporal focus anchor.
Seeking protection from fault anchors the unturning in the focus act.
Speech as held doctrine makes divergence a matter of orientation, not sound alone.
Taking mutually different paths supplies the split trajectories produced by divergent commitments.
Repeated turning away from a proper face supplies the reversible distortion the petition addresses.

structural_cues: 51:8 places the audience inside divergent speech rather than merely reporting separate statements.
51:9 repeats one inversion root around the object from which a person is turned.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies divergent doctrinal paths, inversion, and a deceptive branch under the focus root; I treat that branch as a diagnostic overlay, not as a replacement translation for the dawn noun. A live alternative confines the focus root to time and reads the epistemic context only as contrast.

changed_reading.before: They ask protection from acknowledged moral faults.
changed_reading.after: They also ask to be unturned from the deceptive framings that keep faults from being acknowledged as faults.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context distinguishes two covers by function: one engulfs perception into heedlessness and leaves the subject exposed to assay, while the focus seeks a cover that preserves after awakened admission. The action is therefore an exchange of covers, not a wish to remain unseen.

activation_trace.role: A cover that protects and preserves supplies the desired covering function.
An engulfing mass that covers supplies the rival covering function.
A veil of falsehood and ignorance explains how the rival cover disables recognition.
Heart-level inattention supplies the disabled state produced under engulfment.
Assaying a person as metal supplies the disclosure event against which a merely concealing cover fails.

structural_cues: 51:11 joins immersion and heedlessness in one description.
51:13-14 moves from that disabled state to direct exposure and experienced testing before 51:18 presents active seeking.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an engulfing cover, heedlessness, assay, and a preserving cover; I infer an exchange from the first function to the second. The live alternative is a simpler moral contrast with no shared covering mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Forgiveness covers fault so that the subject is not punished.
changed_reading.after: The dawn act leaves the cover of stupefaction and asks for a different cover, one that protects precisely after fault has been brought into view.

context_deltas.mechanism: Protection, covered cultivation, prior good-doing, reduced sleep, and the night interval form one subject-sequence. Seeking forgiveness is not a late repair by an otherwise negligent group; it is a constitutive rhythm of people already characterized by protection and excellent action.

activation_trace.role: The final night interval supplies the endpoint of the described nocturnal discipline.
Continued seeking of protection from fault supplies the discipline's apparently paradoxical final act.
Placing the self in protection characterizes the same people by an active protective posture.
Cultivated space covered by growth makes protection fruitful rather than merely defensive.
Doing what is good establishes that the petitioners are already agents of excellence.
Small quantity constrains sleep and supplies the cost of the discipline.
Night's darkness supplies the larger interval from which the dawn endpoint emerges.

structural_cues: Plural reference remains continuous across 51:15-18, culminating in the explicit pronoun of the focus.
The branchless root ه ج ع in 51:17 is used only as the sleep predicate governed by the little/night construction, not as invented branch evidence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies protected people, prior excellent action, little night sleep, and dawn seeking; I infer that subject continuity makes these one discipline and that seeking is constitutive rather than remedial only. A live alternative treats each virtue as an independent item in a list.

changed_reading.before: Seeking forgiveness signals that the speakers are chiefly defined by prior wrongdoing.
changed_reading.after: Even people already doing good organize the night around renewed need for protection; admission of insufficiency is itself part of excellence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sequence pivots from the subjects as seekers of protective remission to their property as the site of another's fixed claim. A vertical petition thus activates a horizontal obligation: the one who asks must recognize both the voiced asker and deprivation that may not voice itself.

activation_trace.role: The focus act makes the subjects petitioners for relief from an adverse consequence.
Possessed wealth supplies the concrete domain in which their response to another petition is tested.
A binding entitlement turns generosity from optional sentiment into a due.
Request and demand mirror the petitioning posture of the focus at the human level.
Missing the sought good extends obligation beyond the person who successfully articulates a request.

structural_cues: 51:18 and 51:19 use adjacent initial locative constructions and retain the same plural possessors.
The sequence moves immediately from what they seek to what exists within what they own.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies petition, property, fixed entitlement, voiced request, and deprivation; I supply the arrow from receiving-seeking to answering others' claims. The live alternative is that private devotion and distributive conduct are adjacent virtues without a causal relation.

changed_reading.before: Dawn forgiveness is a private relation between petitioners and God.
changed_reading.after: Their private request rehearses the posture by which they detect and answer claims on their wealth, including deprivation that does not manage to ask.

context_deltas.mechanism: The movement from signs in the earth to signs within the self turns dawn seeking into an act of perception: the self is read as evidence, fault becomes visible, and protective remission is requested in response to what inward sight discovers.

activation_trace.role: Protection from fault anchors inward perception in the focus's requested outcome.
A manifest sign supplies the evidentiary mode of reading.
Stable knowledge after doubt supplies the possible result of attending to evidence.
The thing's own self relocates the field of evidence from external terrain to the petitioners themselves.
Insight of the heart supplies the faculty by which internal signs become morally legible.

structural_cues: 51:20-21 repeats the same locative frame while moving from earth to selves.
The rhetorical question about seeing makes failure of perception, not absence of evidence, the pressure point.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies external and internal signs, stable knowing, insight, and a focus petition about fault; I infer that dawn stillness is used to read the self as evidence. The live alternative is that the sign sequence concerns cosmological recognition without specifying introspective confession.

changed_reading.before: The petition is a fixed verbal formula recited at a favored time.
changed_reading.after: The petition is the voiced result of inward evidence-gathering: at dawn they see the self more clearly and ask protection from what that sight discloses.

context_deltas.mechanism: Provision, promise, established truth, and speech recast forgiveness as received rather than self-produced. The petitioners' utterance becomes an enacted dependence on an apportioned protective gift whose reality exceeds their ability to manufacture it.

activation_trace.role: The sought protection from fault supplies the gift whose source is at issue.
An apportioned grant supplies the received-not-manufactured structure.
A promise opening expectation makes the requested gift depend on another's pledged action.
Reality matching truth stabilizes dependence against suspicion that the promise is empty.
Ordinary speech supplies the immediate experiential analogue by which that reality is asserted.

structural_cues: 51:22 locates provision and promise beyond the speakers' possession.
51:23 grounds the asserted reality by comparison with the speakers' own act of speaking.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies apportioned provision, promise, truth, speech, and a sought protective result; I infer that forgiveness participates in the same received-gift structure. A live alternative restricts provision to sustenance and the promise to the announced future without applying either to forgiveness.

changed_reading.before: Repeated petition is an effort by which the subjects repair themselves.
changed_reading.after: Their speech performs dependence: the protection they seek is approached as apportioned provision they can request and receive but cannot manufacture.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the focus noun's ordinary temporal activation is much nearer than its upper-chest and breathway branch. It remains anchored in the same focus root and gains context support from the self-root's breath and dawn-opening branches. Render it only as a somatic overlay on the dawn reading, never as a replacement lexical translation.

changed_reading.before: The act occurs at a time outside the body.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, dawn seeking is also embodied: the interior opens with breath, acknowledges vulnerability, and asks to be protectively covered.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because a color-switching play-object is branch-distant from the plural dawn noun. It remains traceable through the focus root and the context's divergent paths and repeated inversion. Render it only as a mechanical analogy for reorientation, explicitly qualified as exploratory.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Word 1 has a branch in which pulling from opposite sides changes the displayed color; word 3 supplies covering as the requested transformation.

activation_trace.role: A side-dependent change of visible color supplies a compact mechanism for reversible appearance.
Covering the visible surface supplies the focus-side action in the analogy.
Opposed paths supply the two sides from which the self's presentation can be pulled.
Turning a thing away from its face supplies the reversal that makes a changed display possible.

changed_reading.before: The petition asks that an unchanged self simply be covered.
changed_reading.after: As a contained analogy, the dawn act pulls from the other side of a distorted orientation so that what the self displays can change rather than merely disappear.

strongest_changes: Reckoning and fixity turn the dawn petition into anticipatory preparation before settlement.
Engulfing heedlessness versus preserving forgiveness makes the act an exchange of covers rather than further concealment.
Continuous reference through protection, prior good-doing, little night sleep, and dawn seeking makes the petition a discipline of excellence.
The adjacent fixed claim of the asker and deprived converts private petition into a model for recognizing social obligation.
summary.what_was_special: The focus roots form an edge-and-cover mechanism that context repeatedly reactivates through burden, inversion, rival coverings, protection, request, entitlement, inward sight, and received provision. The body and color-switch branches remain live only as explicitly contained overlays.
remaining_uncertainties: The burden-processing sequence in 51:1-4 may be a productive analogy rather than an intended causal model.
The deceptive, bodily, and color-switch branches of the time-root may be latent overlays with no lexical force in the focus occurrence.
The arrow from seeking divine protection to answering human claims is inferred from adjacency and parallel structure, not stated.
Treating forgiveness as provision extends the grant structure of 51:22-23 beyond what those verses explicitly name.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Predawn becomes a recurring shelter-seeking interval.** `س ح ر/B004` supplies the last part of night before morning; `غ ف ر/B002` gives forgiveness as shielding from consequence, with B001 the underlying protective cover. Placed after curtailed sleep and before material right-giving, seeking forgiveness is one phase in a disciplined cycle. I infer **wakeful predawn exposure -> seeking protective pardon**. The act reads as entering cover precisely as night-cover recedes.
2. **Inner repair precedes social payment.** The sequence 51:18-19 joins forgiveness-seeking to giving a due share. The packet does not state causation; I infer **acknowledged liability -> repaired relation -> recognition of others' claims**. `غ ف ر/B002` performs the repair role within the fixed ayah.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 51:59-60 made forgiveness's protective function sharper: predawn seeking anticipates liability before the allotted consequence becomes its owner's day.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Protective covering sought at a perceptual threshold.** **Lexical evidence:** fixed `س ح ر/B004` is “the predawn time”; fixed `غ ف ر/B001` is “protective covering,” while `B002` specifies forgiving that shields from consequence. **Structural cue:** fiery assay lies at 51:13–14, protected gardens and reduced night sleep at 51:15–17, and the window then turns to due sharing, visible signs, sight, provision, and asserted truth in 51:19–23. **Role and abduction:** forgiveness supplies a shield, and predawn supplies the transition from covering darkness toward visibility; I infer that the chosen time materially models movement from concealed fault toward discernible order. **Reading change:** seeking forgiveness becomes an act of re-covering for protection precisely as night’s obscuring cover begins to recede.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 51:19–23’s progression through right, visible signs, sight, provision, and truth confirmed predawn as a threshold from concealment into accountable visibility.

concept_map.definition: Boğazın ucu ile yemek borusuna bağlanan, akciğer ve göğsün üst kesimiyle ilişkilendirilen iç organ bölgesidir. Bu bölgeden hareketle korkudan için kabarması, kesimde çıkarılan parça ve geniş karınlı ya da bu bölgesi hasta canlı gibi özel kullanımlar doğar.

facets.statement: Boğazın ucu, yemek borusunun üst karın tarafı, akciğer ve göğsün üst kesimiyle bağlantılı bir iç organ bölgesini belirtir.
Bazı anlatımlar bu bölgeyi doğrudan akciğer, bazılarıysa üst göğüs ya da boğaza yapışık hafif doku olarak sınırlar.
Korku ve ürkme, bu iç bölgenin kabarıp içi doldurması görüntüsüyle anlatılır.
Hayvan kesilirken bu bölgeden ve ona bağlı dokulardan çıkarılıp atılan parçaya özel bir ad verilir.
Aynı anatomik temelden geniş karınlı veya bu bölgesinden rahatsız canlı nitelemesi ile iç boşluğu bulunduğu için besine gereksinen yaratık anlayışı türetilir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Genel aldatma ve saptırma çekirdeği korunurken etkileyici söz, göz yanıltma ve bozuk yiyecek, toprak, hayvan ya da yağmur kullanımları kendi bağlamlarına bağlı tutulur.

facets.statement: Yanlışı doğru görünümünde sunarak kişiyi aldatır veya gözün gerçekte olmayan bir şeyi varmış gibi algılamasına yol açar.
Bazı anlatımlarda gizli güçlerden yardım alma ya da onlara yaklaşma yoluyla yapılan doğaüstü işlem olarak sınırlandırılır.
Çok etkili ve ustalıklı söz, gönülleri konuşanın yönüne çevirdiği için aynı saptırıcı güce benzetilir.
Birini bulunduğu yönden çevirmek, kandırmak veya olağan durumundan uzaklaştırmak fiil olarak bu çekirdeği sürdürür.
Yiyeceğin işlevinin bozulması, toprağın ürün vermemesi, keçinin sütünün azalması veya aşırı yağmurun zarar vermesi gibi sonuçlara genişletilir.
İşlemi yapan kişi ile işlemden etkilenip aklı veya durumu olağan çizgiden çıkan kişi ayrı katılımcılar olarak adlandırılır.

concept_map.definition: Gecenin sonunda, tanın doğmasından hemen önce karanlığın gündüz aydınlığıyla karışmaya başladığı zaman dilimidir. Bu vakte girme, o sırada yola çıkma veya erken davranma ve kuşların o vakitte ötmesi aynı zaman ilişkisine dayanır.

facets.statement: Gecenin son parçasını ve sabah ışığının belirmesinden hemen önceki vakti belirtir.
Bu vakit, son gece karanlığının gündüz aydınlığıyla karışması olarak betimlenir.
Vaktin üst ucu, sabahın ilk soluklanmasının başladığı en ileri bölüm olarak ayrılır.
Bu vakte girmek, bu sırada yola çıkmak veya erken davranmak zaman adından türeyen eylemlerdir.
Horoz veya başka bir kuşun bu vakitte ötmesi de aynı zaman bağıyla anlatılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar bu zamanı gecenin sonu ve tan öncesi parça olarak ortaklaştırır; ayrıca karanlıkla gündüz ışığının karıştığı geçişi vurgular. Bu zamana girme, bu sırada hareket etme, erken çıkma ve kuşların ötmesi zaman adından türeyen kullanımlardır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bir şeyin kenarı veya sonu, çölün kıyıları ve vadinin üst kesimi için açık bir uzamsal kullanım verir; ayrıca siyahın üstünde görünen beyazlığı ayrı bir kullanım olarak ekler. Bu iki alan tek bir belirsiz 'uç' tanımında eritilmemelidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Uzamsal anlam belirli tamlamalarda kenar, son veya üst uçtur; siyah üzerinde beliren beyazlık ise ayrı bir renk görünümü olarak tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Belirli ad birliklerinde bir şeyin kenarını, sonunu veya üst ucunu; özellikle çölün kıyılarını ve vadinin üst kesimini belirtir. Ayrı bir renk kullanımında siyah zemin üzerinde beliren beyazlığı anlatır.

facets.statement: Bir şeyin kenarı, son sınırı veya üst ucu anlamı belirli ad birlikleri içinde kurulur.
Açık ve ıssız arazinin çoğul biçimde anılan kenarlarını belirtir.
Vadiyle birlikte kullanıldığında vadinin üst kesimini veya yukarı ucunu gösterir.
Uzamsal uç anlamından ayrı olarak siyahın üzerinde görünen beyaz tabaka veya beyazlık için kullanılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tek kaynaklı anlatım uzamsal alanda bir şeyin kenarı veya sonunu, çölün kıyılarını ve vadinin üst kesimini birlikte verir. Siyah yüzeyin üstündeki beyazlık aynı kayıtta yer alan ayrı bir renk görünümüdür ve uzamsal tanımla özdeşleştirilmemelidir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi örtmeyi, örtülen şeyi kirden ya da zarardan korumayı ve başlık, bez, bulut, kap ile ilgili özel gerçekleşmeleri birlikte destekler. Bu nedenle dalın koruyarak örtme çerçevesi kaynak anlamını doğru biçimde temsil eder.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dalın çekirdeği fiziksel ya da işlevsel örtme ve korumadır; suçun bağışlanması, hastalığın kötüleşmesi ve öteki eş adlı anlamlar buna katılmaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Çıplak örtme çekirdeği ile başlık, bez, bulut ve belirli söz öbeklerine bağlı kullanımlar ayrı tutulur; özel kullanımlar bütün dala yayılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi örterek görünürlükten, kirden ya da zarardan korumak ve bu işi gören örtü veya koruyucu katmanı belirtmektir. Bazı kullanımlar, eşyayı kaba koyma ya da bir işi gereken biçimde örtüp düzeltme gibi belirli yapılara bağlıdır.

facets.statement: Temel işlem, bir şeyi örterek onu dış etkiden korumak ya da görünmez kılmaktır.
Başı koruyan zırh başlığı, başörtüsünü yağdan sakınan bez, yay çentiğindeki yama ve başka bir bulutu örten bulut bu çekirdeğin özel örnekleridir.
Eşyayı bir kaba koyma, kumaşı kiri daha iyi gizler duruma getirme ve bir işi uygun biçimde örtüp düzeltme yalnızca belirtilen yapılarda geçerlidir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar örtme ile korumayı ortak çekirdek sayar; koruyucu başlık ve çeşitli bez ya da örtü türleri bu çekirdeği somutlaştırırken kap, kumaş ve iş düzenleme kullanımları belirli yapılara bağlı kalır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi kumaşın kabaran havını, insan bedenindeki ince tüyü ve enseden sarkan saçı aynı yüzeyi kaplayan kıl katmanı çevresinde toplar. Verilen dal imgesi bu ortak görünüşü doğru yansıtır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal doğal ya da dokuma yüzeyindeki ince kıl ve havla sınırlıdır; yapılmış örtüler ve soyut bağışlama anlamı buna girmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Kumaş havı ve ince tüy adları ile kumaş havının kabarmasını ya da ensedeki saçı örtmeyi anlatan yapılara bağlı kullanımlar ayrı tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Bir yüzeyi kaplayan ince tüy, saç ya da kumaş havı ve özellikle kumaş havının kabarıp yüzeyi örtmesi anlam alanıdır. Ensedeki sarkan saç ve onu örtme buyruğu belirli kullanımlardır.

facets.statement: İnce tüy veya kumaş havı, bulunduğu yüzeyin üstünü kıl benzeri bir katmanla kaplar.
Kumaşta bu anlam, havın kalkıp kumaş yüzünü kaplaması biçiminde gerçekleşir.
Bacak veya alın üstündeki ince tüy ile enseden aşağı sarkan saç da aynı adlandırma alanına girer.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar kumaş yüzünde kabaran havı ortak biçimde belirtir; ayrıca beden yüzeyindeki ince tüy ve enseden sarkan saç, yüzeyi örten kıl görünümünün başka gerçekleşmeleri olarak verilir.

concept_gloss.text: yüzeyi kaplayan ince tüy veya kumaş havı

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi hem yaranın hem hastanın yeniden kötüleşmesini aynı hastalık gerilemesi anlamında açıkça verir. Dalın iyileşmeden sonra kötü duruma dönme açıklaması bu anlamı doğru sınırlar.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Anlam yalnızca yara veya hastanın yeniden kötüleştiği yapılarda geçerlidir; genel hastalık, yaralanma ya da fiziksel örtme anlamına genişletilmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal yalnızca yara veya hasta öznesiyle kurulan kötüleşme yapılarında tanıklıdır; bağımsız ve genel bir kök anlamı sayılmaz.

Kötüleşen katılımcı bir yara veya hasta olabilir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi dağ keçisinin yavrusunu ve bu yavrunun annesini farklı türemiş adlarla açıkça eşleştirir. Dal tek bir canlıyı değil, kaynakta birlikte verilen anne-yavru adlandırma çiftini temsil ettiği sürece çerçeve doğrudur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Yavru ile anne aynı varlık değildir; kavram haritası iki ayrı göndergeyi ve aralarındaki anne-yavru ilişkisini korur.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal, verilen bağımsız adların dağ keçisi yavrusu ve onun annesi için kullanımıyla sınırlıdır; başka hayvan yavrularına genişletilmez.

Kaynaklarda anne için iki ayrı türemiş biçim verilir; gönderge yine yavrunun annesidir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar yavru adında birleşir; anne içinse aynı söz ailesinden iki farklı biçim verir. Her durumda yavru ile anne ayrı katılımcılar olarak korunur.

concept_gloss.applicability: Kaynakta birlikte tanımlanan yavru adını ve annesine ait iki ad biçimini tek başlıkta eksiksiz temsil eder.

error_profile.preserves: Hayvan türünü, yavru ile anne ayrımını ve aralarındaki yakınlık ilişkisini korur.
